notes.title: Game News
notes.content:
[h3][b]CEO and Owner “General Script Studio” SERHII KHRAMOV answered some popular questions from the Ukrainian audience regarding the game “Ukrainians: Our battle”.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217581/5f31f8925ceea2ee8812e0993db4389a721fd802.jpg[/img]

[i][b]1. Will this game be the most successful for the studio?[/b][/i]

– It is impossible to guarantee success with absolute certainty. We have several powerful factors that are positive for us. In particular, these are such things as the level of graphics, the possibilities for game promotion, as well as its plot. In fact, there are still many things that are implemented better in this game than in the studio’s previous projects. This gives hope for achieving a record number of players for us when the time comes for the release.

[i][b]2. Can the official release date be postponed?[/b][/i]

– Unfortunately, I have to say that this scenario is the most likely. The thing is that we cannot make it all on time. This project must be perfect from all points of view, so we are working not only on global tasks, but also pay attention to the little things, bugs, elements of plot logic, and so on.

[i][b]3. How did you manage to achieve such a dramatic improvement in graphics?[/b][/i]

– Most of the graphics elements that you will be able to see in the game were developed by our new team members. These are students from educational institutions in Kyiv who expressed interest in joining the game development team after completing my 3D modeling course.

[i][b]4. How much will the game cost and will it have paid add-ons?[/b][/i]

– I cannot reveal any details about pricing at this stage of the project’s development. However, I can say for sure that the game will not be free. We plan to send half of the net profit to charity. You can follow all this on our social networks, as well as in this game news feed. As for the add-ons, I can say that they are planned. But their number will not be large. In addition, the absence of paid add-ons will not significantly limit the main functionality of the game.
